rebuttal_or_critique: While I remain deeply committed to supporting the rural economy and ensuring that agricultural growth is not constrained, the persistence of headline CPI at 7.01% and core inflation at 6.20% indicates that inflationary pressures have become broad-based. The positive output gap of 0.40% and the surplus liquidity of 190,000 crore INR provide a window for front-loaded action. Given that inflation has remained outside our tolerance band for several months, I believe a 50 bps hike is necessary to prevent the entrenchment of price pressures, which would ultimately be more detrimental to the rural consumer and overall growth than a measured, front-loaded monetary tightening. I align with the majority to ensure the credibility of our mandate.
